'''Doan''' was a small [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] whose sole economy was focused on [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. It was ruled by a group of [[Noble/Legends|nobles]], the [[Doan Royal House]], while most of its population were miners who lived in poverty.

==History==
===Early history===
Doan was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] sometime before 10,980 BBY. Scattered across the surface were five kilometer tall natural columns of stone that were several hundred meters in diameter. The plateaus on the surface of these columns were covered in mansions, castles, and palaces which overlooked the rest of the surface below.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the official [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of Doan had been assassinated and his death was investigated.<ref name="senator">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Death of a Senator}}</ref> At the same time, mining operations reported massive underground chambers teeming with subterranean life. The underground caverns turned out to contain rare subterranean [[Lichen/Legends|lichens]] and [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] with remarkable properties.<ref name="Mines">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|The Mines of Doan}}</ref> Parallel to these events, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Edruu]] hit the headlines when embarrassing [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] were anonymously transmitted across the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].<ref name="Fool">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Prince of Fools}}</ref>

===Golden Age of the Old Republic===
{{Quote|Your son was beloved by all the nobles of Doan.|Serra, to the King of Doan, on Gerran|<ref name="DOE" />}}
In [[980 BBY]] during the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]], a war erupted between the planet's nobles and the [[mining caste]] after the [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]] was accidentally killed by the miners, who had been attempting to force his [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] into an emergency landing.<ref name="DOE" />

Three months later, Gerran's widow, Princess [[Serra]], had the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|captured]] and taken to the secret [[Stone Prison]] on Doan, where she interrogated him. However, he escaped and was confronted by his apprentice, [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]. After a brief [[Duel on Doan|duel]] they were separated and forced to flee as Serra initiated the [[Prison/Legends|prison's]] self-destruct sequence, causing the entire underground complex to collapse.<ref name="DOE" />
